description: This file defines the client-side logic for the 'Sales Funnel' page in an ERPNext application, including page load initialization, the SalesFunnel class with setup, data retrieval, and rendering methods for funnel and chart visualizations.

classes.name: SalesFunnel
classes.description: Client-side class managing the sales funnel page, including setup, data fetching, and rendering funnel and chart visualizations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the SalesFunnel instance, sets up the page after a timeout.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures page elements, default options, and event bindings for user interactions.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches sales funnel data from server based on current options and updates the visualization.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Determines which visualization to render based on selected chart type.

methods.name: render_funnel
methods.description: Draws the sales funnel diagram on a canvas element.

methods.name: prepare_funnel
methods.description: Prepares data and canvas for funnel rendering, including size calculations.

methods.name: draw_triangle
methods.description: Draws a triangle shape on the canvas for funnel segments.

methods.name: draw_legend
methods.description: Draws a legend item with line, circle, and label for funnel segments.

methods.name: render_chart
methods.description: Renders a bar chart visualization of sales data.
